I've replied to Pree in our DM confirming her standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team for the Moorland rollout: Mondays at 9:30 from now on. As she asked, I didn't change anything else.

I told her I have no separate place to store things. What I do have is this DM, which I can look back at if she asks me about it here. I offered to add a weekly Monday 9:30 event to her calendar if she wants a lasting record, and asked her to say which time zone if it isn't Central.
